description: The response time of an HTTP request to a given URL. The metric is tagged with the URL, such as `url:http://example.com`. When `enable_http_outcome_tag` is set to `true`, the metric is also tagged with `http_outcome`, set to the HTTP status code of the response.

Whether the check reported the endpoint as up, where `1` is up and `0` is down. The metric is tagged with the URL, such as `url:http://example.com`. When `enable_http_outcome_tag` is set to `true`, the metric is also tagged with `http_outcome`, set to the HTTP status code of the response or the reason why no response was received.

Whether the check reported the endpoint as down, where `1` is down and `0` is up. The metric is tagged with the URL, such as `url:http://example.com`. When `enable_http_outcome_tag` is set to `true`, the metric is also tagged with `http_outcome`, set to the HTTP status code of the response or the reason why no response was received.
Number of days until the SSL certificate expires
Number of seconds until the SSL certificate expires
